meta.titleArchery: Archery game — shoot a bow at a 3D target online — cv.cm
meta.descArchery: Play archery online for free: draw the bow, steady the sight and shoot at a ten-ring target from 18, 30, 50 or 70 m. Read the wind, score six ends of three arrows and beat your best.

archery.name: Archery
archery.blurb: Draw, aim into the wind and hit the gold.

archery.q1: How do I shoot an arrow?
archery.a1: Press and hold on the target (or hold Space) to draw the bow, move the sight onto your mark, and let go to shoot. A full draw takes under a second; let go too early and the arrow drops low.
archery.a2: The target has ten rings worth 1 to 10 from the outside in. An arrow touching a line gets the higher ring, and the small inner 10 counts as an X, which breaks ties. A round is six ends of three arrows, 180 points at most.
archery.a3: The flag beside the target and the wind value show a side wind that changes every end. It pushes the arrow sideways more at longer distances, so aim a little into the wind.
archery.a4: Like a real archer's, your aim sways. It steadies about a second after you start to draw and starts to shake again if you hold for more than four seconds, so shoot in that calm window.
archery.q5: Does it work on a phone?
archery.a5: Yes. Touch and hold the target to draw, slide to aim and lift your finger to shoot. Your best round for each distance is saved in this browser.

archery.lead: Shoot a round of archery in three steps.
archery.s1b: Pick 18, 30, 50 or 70 m and press Play. The face is bigger at the longer distances.
archery.s2b: Hold on the target or hold Space. Wait for the sight to settle and allow for the wind.
archery.s3b: Let go to shoot. Three arrows make an end; six ends make a round.
